name: Manually unlatched NO contact
summary: A manually unlatched NO contact includes a mechanical retaining action released by a documented manual operation.
description: A manually unlatched NO contact includes a mechanical retaining action released by a documented manual operation. Its schematic modifier explains why removal of an initiating signal may not restore the initial state.
readingNotes: Follow the manual reset to the retaining device tag.
